title: Analysis code for haemagglutinin antigenic-site conservation in Egyptian H5Nx and H9N2 avian influenza viruses, 2010-2026

creators.name: Khalil, Ahmed Aly
creators.affiliation: Veterinary Serum and Vaccine Research Institute (VSVRI), Agricultural Research Center, Abbasia, Cairo, Egypt

description:
Analysis and figure code, column-to-H3 numbering maps, accession lists and derived results for a study of haemagglutinin antigenic-site conservation and clade replacement in Egyptian H5Nx and H9N2 avian influenza viruses, 2010-2026 (data cut-off 28 September 2026).

Sequence data are not included. GISAID EpiFlu data may not be redistributed; the GISAID component is identified by EPI_SET_260928dp (H5) and EPI_SET_260928rz (H9). The GenBank component is exactly reconstructable from the retrieval scripts, which bound the query on record publication date.
